reply_text:
I replied to Hollis in a thread on his #central-team message. I told him the "Bay 24" tip is still unconfirmed: nothing he can see mentions an Osprey rollout or Bay 24 for Quarrendon Freight Lines. I checked #central-team, #general and the shared notes. #general came back with no messages.

I suggested he ask Dana Okafor to confirm the site. Notes from 2025 and 2026 say QFL is a North team account she took over, and Thea Ramaswell is the contact at QFL. Until Dana confirms it, the tip is just hearsay.

There's also a #inc-qfl-sev1 incident channel, but Hollis isn't a member, so I didn't read it for him.
